Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Exact PvP cues, Smart Tab, reliable held helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with exact native-nameplate cues, LB notifications, pressure and CC awareness, PvP range rings, a Wolves' Den CC rotation panel, a bounded Purify-first held scheduler, Smart Tab, Emergency Teleport, assist macros, local MP sounds, job tools, and target highlights.
Changelog: Added a default-off instant-leave option for completed public Crystalline Conflict matches. It reuses the exact complete 10-player result capture, attempts local W/L persistence first when enabled, waits for FFXIV's native leave-ready boundary, then sends exactly one normal non-forced leave request. The 10-second in-memory intent cancels on context, territory, identity, transition, toggle, or native-boundary drift and never retries the void request. Wolves' Den, custom matches, Frontline, Rival Wings, and automatic re-queueing are excluded. Configuration schema 48; all 570 Core tests and release gates pass. The current-client post-result transition remains live in-game validation.
